jobs.description:
Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly? As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:00 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.
(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

jobs.occupation: Sr KAM Off Trade - Non food company
jobs.description:
The company is a leading international FMCG player in the non-food sector, offering a diverse portfolio of trusted consumer products across categories such as personal care, household, and lifestyle essentials. Known for its strong brands, innovation-driven mindset, and commitment to sustainability, it combines global scale with local market expertise. The organization places a strong emphasis on quality, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement, making it a dynamic and forward-thinking environment within the fast-moving consumer goods industry.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior KAM, you will be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of key retail accounts, developing tailored commercial strategies to drive distribution, visibility, and long-term profitable growth. You will act as the primary point of contact for your customers, ensuring strong partnerships and flawless execution in the market.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and develop strategic relationships with key off-trade customers in the non-food channel.
• Negotiate annual agreements, pricing, and promotional plans to deliver sustainable growth.
• Develop and execute joint business plans aligned with customer and company objectives.
• Drive distribution, shelf presence, and visibility of product ranges across retail partners.
• Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer performance to identify opportunities.
• Collaborate closely with marketing, supply chain, and category teams to ensure execution excellence.
• Deliver against sales, profitability, and market share targets.
• Provide regular performance analysis and strategic recommendations to senior management.

• Proven experience in Key Account Management within FMCG, preferably in non-food or general merchandise.
• Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation skills.
• Ability to build long-term, trust-based relationships with retail partners.
• Analytical mindset with strong understanding of sales data and category performance.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-oriented approach.
• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in the Brabant Wallon
jobs.description:
As part of the finance team, you will take ownership of several legal entities across Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg, with the opportunity to gradually expand your responsibilities and make a visible impact on the organization's future.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the full accounting cycle for several entities across Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg.
• Handle daily accounting operations, including purchase invoices, bank transactions, payments, reconciliations, and journal entries.
• Prepare monthly and year-end closings, provisions, accruals, and supporting financial analyses.
• Ensure timely VAT, Intrastat, and statutory reporting obligations are met.
• Prepare annual accounts and support audit activities in collaboration with the Chief Accountant.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting processes and support ad hoc finance projects.

• Holds a degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent professional experience.
• Speaks fluent French and Dutch ; English is a great asset.
• Has solid end-to-end accounting experience and is comfortable managing entities autonomously.
• Has a strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, VAT, and statutory obligations.
• Is structured, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.
• Demonstrates ambition, curiosity, and a willingness to take on increasing responsibilities over time.
• Thrives in a pragmatic, hands-on, and collaborative environment where initiative is valued.

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!
